why: Argo runs on v3 only when the sibling becomes the served app. The flip is configuration only and ships first, alone, so a bad flip rolls back with `make rollback` while the old app still exists.
what: Serve and build apps/dashboard-v3 at the root, drop the /v3/ mount and its env, and change the boot script's scheme key. apps/dashboard stays in the tree, unreferenced.
must_not_touch: apps/api/src/** except the five files named
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1, 6.2 and the scheme rule (the app owns one key; the cutover PR is where the boot script changes). Precondition (the lead checks it, read only): ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/docs/v3/verdicts/argo-ledger.md is on master with no empty or `reopened` verdict cell, and `bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-test-ledger-argo.ts --complete --argo-root ~/SourceRoot/argo` exits 0 there; if not, stop and report. Reversal of v3-argo-chain: each APP default and the /v3/ mount it added is removed or flipped.
exemplar: The diff of v3-argo-chain and v3-argo-scaffold, reversed.
change: 1. APP default dashboard-v3 in Makefile, deploy.sh, dev.sh, design-shot, evidence; the plist's DASHBOARD_DIR points at apps/dashboard-v3/dist and DASHBOARD_V3_DIR, v3Dir and the /v3/ branch are deleted (env.ts, index.ts, serve-dashboard, tests); Vite base `/`, router basepath removed. 2. Scheme: the boot script reads the legacy `mantine-color-scheme-value` once and writes `basalt:scheme`; if the installed theme-script only reads, the app's main.tsx writes it, with a comment. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code. The flip is one commit; the scheme change another.
proof: `make deploy` runs on push; then `make version` equals origin/master and `make verify` exits 0; `make evidence LABEL=cutover` bundle and lighthouse numbers in the PR body; rollback is `make rollback`.
acceptance: `bun test apps/api/src` exits 0 with serve-dashboard.test.ts on the root mount and no /v3/ case
`rg -n 'DASHBOARD_V3_DIR|v3Dir|/v3' apps/api deploy scripts Makefile apps/dashboard-v3/vite.config.ts apps/dashboard-v3/src/lib` returns no match
a DOM test of the boot script: with only `mantine-color-scheme-value=dark` set the resolved theme is dark and `basalt:scheme` equals dark afterwards; with both keys set `basalt:scheme` wins
after the factory deploy `make version` prints origin/master's sha, `make verify` exits 0 and `make verify-pages BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7737` reports PASS for every line of scripts/evidence/routes.txt
out_of_scope: Deleting apps/dashboard, init at the root, renaming apps/dashboard-v3, API changes, restyling.
